newText: Convenience always extracts a tax on composability, and centralizing prompt management inside a custom ComfyUI node is no exception. You are effectively locking valuable prompt metadata into proprietary JSON workflows that git can't easily parse or diff, making team-based collaboration on complex pipelines far harder. The immediate losers here are enterprise teams trying to build reproducible, code-first generative pipelines outside of a single designer's local canvas.
